name: Monstera
hook: No splits in your Monstera? Give it brighter light and time.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Near a bright east or west window; harsh summer sun scorches leaves, low light means no splits.

steps.title: Water when top 5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Soak until it drains, then let the top 2–5 cm dry; water a little less often in winter.

steps.title: Chunky, airy mix
steps.tip: Mix potting soil with orchid bark or perlite so roots get air and never sit soggy.

steps.title: Give it a moss pole
steps.tip: Tie stems to a moss pole; climbing triggers bigger, more split leaves.

steps.title: Cut below a node
steps.tip: Snip a stem with a node and aerial root, root it in water, then pot it once roots look sturdy.

outro: Bright light + patient watering = those iconic split leaves.
